CITY OF SAN MARINO

  PLANNING COMMISSION AGENDA

Shelley Boyle, Chair
John Dustin, Vice Chair  www.sanmarinoca.gov
Kevin Cheng, Commissioner  (626) 300­0700 Phone
Joyce Gatsoulis­Batnij, Commissioner  San Marino City Hall
Sharon Mequet, Commissioner  2200 Huntington Drive
  San Marino, CA 91108

  SPECIAL MEETING OF THE
  PLANNING COMMISSION
  TUESDAY, OCTOBER 15, 2024 AT 6:00 PM
  CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  2200 HUNTINGTON DRIVE
  SAN MARINO, CA 91108

The City of San Marino appreciates your attendance. Citizens’ interest provides the Planning
Commission with valuable information regarding issues of the community.

Regular meetings are held on the 4th Wednesday of every month at 6:00 p.m.

In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who
requires a reasonable modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting
should contact the City at Planning@SanMarinoCA.gov or by phone at (626) 300­0700 prior
to the meeting for assistance.

The public is welcome to attend the meeting in person or remotely via Zoom, however, the
meeting will proceed as normal even if there are technical difficulties with Zoom. The City will
do it’s best to resolve any technical issues as quickly as possible.

How to participate in the meeting from home:
Visit www.SanMarinoCA.gov/Zoom

How to offer public comment from home:
  1. Public comment will be accepted by email to Planning@SanMarinoCA.gov before or
  during the meeting prior to the close of public comment on an item, to be read during
  public comment. Lengthy public comment may be summarized in the interest of time.

  2. Public comment will be accepted electronically via the zoom.us teleconference module
  during the meeting. Zoom comments will be taken after the in­person comments.

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

Alternate Ching Chiao, Alternate Brett Leitner, Commissioner Joyce Gatsoulis­Batnij,
Commissioner Sharon Mequet, Commissioner Kevin Cheng, Vice Chair John Dustin, and
Chair Shelley Boyle
POSTING OF AGENDA

The agenda is posted 72 hours prior to each meeting at the following locations: City Hall,
2200 Huntington Drive, the Crowell Public Library, 1890 Huntington Drive, and the Stoneman
Building, 1560 Pasqualito Drive. The agenda is also posted on the City’s website:
http://www.sanmarinoca.gov.

PUBLIC COMMENTS

The City welcomes public input. Members of the public may address the Planning Commission
by submitting a public comment request and giving it to the Community Development Director
prior to the meeting. At this time, the public may address the Planning Commission on items
that are not on the agenda. Pursuant to state law, the Planning Commission may not discuss
or take action on issues not on the meeting agenda (Government Code Section 54954.3).
 The Chair reserves the right to place limits on duration of comments. Staff may be asked to
follow up on such items.

  PUBLIC HEARINGS

1.  CONSIDERATION OF APPROVAL FOR DESIGN REVIEW CASE NO. DR
  21­66 AND DR 24­77 AT 1825 EL MOLINO AVENUE TO CONSTRUCT
  A NEW TWO­STORY HOME AND THE REMOVAL OF (5) ESTABLISHED
  TREES AND (3) HERITAGE TREES. (LCRA)
  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Planning Commission:1. Determine that
  based on the whole of the administrative record, the proposed roofing project is
  exempt from CEQA pursuant to State CEQA Guidelines, Section 15301, Class 3 (New
  Construction or Conversion of Small Structures), and that there is no substantial
  evidence demonstrating an exception to the categorical exemption pursuant to CEQA
  Guidelines Section 15300.2 applies; 2. Find that the proposed project meets the
  required findings; and 3. Approve the project.

2.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES
  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the Planning Commission approve the
  regular meeting of September 25, 2024.

3.  ADOPTION OF APPROVAL RESOLUTION NO. PCR 24­10 FOR A
  CERTIFICATE OF APPROPRIATENESS AT 708 WINSTON AVENUE
  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No.
  PCR 24­10 approving a Certificate of Appropriateness at 708 Winston Avenue.

DIRECTOR'S REPORT

This is an opportunity for the Community Development Director to inform the Planning
Commission and the public of any matters of interest.

WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS OR PUBLIC WRITINGS DISTRIBUTION

This is an opportunity to announce any written communications pertaining to the City
received by members of the Planning Commission. All public writings distributed by the City
of San Marino to at least a majority of the Planning Commission regarding any item on this
agenda will be made available at the Public Counter at City Hall located at 2200 Huntington
Drive, San Marino, California 91108, and will also be included in the public agenda packet
that will available for review at the Planning Commission meeting.
